Lena: Hey team — I'm Lena (joined sales today). Quick q: I don't see a HubSpot seat yet. Can someone confirm who to ping for CRM access and Gong? Also need the Dialpad login and the SDR playbook links. Thanks!
Aisha (Sales Ops): Welcome Lena! We provision HubSpot seats via Okta group 'sales-core'. Ping @it-ops with your Okta email or I can raise the ticket.
Lena: thanks — my okta email is lena@redwood.ai
Aisha (Sales Ops): Got it. I'm opening a ticket now -> INC-5427. If you need immediate access to call logs, use Dialpad web: https://dialpad.redwood.com and log in with SSO. If SSO fails, DM me.
Ben (IT): @Aisha I see the request, adding HubSpot seat + Gong listener role. Expect invite in ~10-20m. Also Dialpad should be auto-provisioned; if not use this reset flow:
Ben (IT): ```
1) SSO -> Settings -> Link accounts
2) Run /provision-dialpad lena@redwood.ai
```
Lena: Awesome — got HubSpot email invite. can someone point me to the SDR playbook and the pitch deck collateral? where do we find call templates?
Carla (Rev Enablement): Welcome! SDR playbook here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/REV/pages/SDR+Playbook. Call templates live in Confluence under 'Outbound > Scripts'. Decks in Google Drive: /Sales/Decks/PLG-Intro. If you want a short checklist, here's a TL;DR:
Carla (Rev Enablement): - HubSpot: create contact view 'My New Leads'
- Dialpad: test call to +1 415 555 0101
- Gong: mark first 5 calls as 'training'
- Slack: join #sales-win-room
Lena: super helpful, doing the test call now… :phone: 
Onboarding Bot: Lena completed step 'Dialpad test call' — congrats :tada: Claim onboarding credit in the console.
Lena: saw the Gong invite too. Thanks everyone! One more: who should I add as my mentor shadow for the week?
Aisha (Sales Ops): I recommend tagging @jordan for shadowing — he's running the SDR sprints. Jordan, can you take Lena for a 1:1 today?
Jordan: Yep, happy to — 3pm works. Welcome aboard Lena! :wave: 
Lena: 3pm works. Thanks all :raised_hands:
